Known issues

This section lists known issues in Red Hat Developer Hub 2.1.

Bulk import reports success when a pull request cannot be created

When the approval tool rejects the pull request, the import still reports success.

Additional resources

  • Check each imported repository for its pull request, remove catalog locations without one, and retry.
  • RHDHBUGS-4016

Styles on other pages render incorrectly

After you open Docs or TechDocs, other pages can render incorrectly until reload.
